name: @arp-protocol/cli
description: ARP's agent-side programs in one binary: the MCP server, the runtime hook that records what an agent used, and the opt-in hire node. Runs on Node 22 or later.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target=node --format=esm --splitting --entry-naming '[name].js' --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name]-[hash].js' --external viem --external 'viem/*' --external ./hook.js --external @metamask/smart-accounts-kit --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build ../hook/src/hook.ts --outfile dist/hook.js --target=node --format=esm --external viem --external 'viem/*'
